title: Claimed average

choices: accept that the average is exactly 27.2
reject the null, because the interval is narrow
reject the null, because 27.2 is not the sample mean
not reject the null, because 27.2 is inside the interval
explanations: Not rejecting doesn't prove the null is exactly true.
Any value inside the CI is plausible.

solution: 27.2 is inside the 95% CI, so we don't reject the null at the 5% cut-off.
